# UReady

> UReady is a career development platform in Egypt. It connects students, graduates and professionals with mentors and experts, workshops, challenges, events and communities for every specialty. Slogan: "The future belongs to the Ready."

- [What is UReady](https://ureadyeg.github.io/about.html): plain-text overview, features and FAQ
- [Website and app](https://ureadyeg.github.io/): the platform
- [Terms](https://ureadyeg.github.io/terms.html)
- [Privacy](https://ureadyeg.github.io/privacy.html)
